publishingPolicy: Each batch must have unique recipe IDs/names, measured ingredients, practical instructions, accurately matched photographs, a traceable source/license if imported, and a passing CI audit before catalog publication.

prioritize: Chicken, beef, pork, turkey, and seafood meals
Chinese and other Asian dishes with familiar proteins
Southern comfort food and homestyle cooking
Italian pasta, soups, stews, casseroles, and American classics
recipePreferences.notes: No tofu-focused recipes or mock-meat substitutes in new expansion batches. Soy sauce and conventional Asian seasonings are fine. Do not alter existing 166 recipes.
